$comment: The component catalog: what each piece needs, and the smallest install for each goal. `npm run add -- <profile> --to <your app>` and docs/components.md read it.

avatar.summary: Render a Live2D or Inochi2D avatar in your React app.

avatar-generator.summary: Generate an Inochi2D avatar from a description, in your Node.js service. Needs an image API key.

format.summary: Read, validate, and edit courseware JSON, in any JavaScript runtime.

player.summary: Play courseware in your React app.

editor.summary: Edit courseware in your React app.

embed.summary: Put the editor, player, or avatar in any web page through an iframe, with no React.

cli.summary: Author courseware from the command line or a coding agent, without a server.

studio.summary: A complete courseware system: list, edit, preview, and agent authoring.
Web app, local host, and embedded stores; starts courseware-service.

courseware-service.summary: Courseware storage, assets, the agent's MCP endpoint, and the editor's AI assistant.

video-render-service.summary: Exports courseware as video. Only needed for video export.
